title: Unique identity-coordinate transpose before extension
statement: In the setting of [def-sfb-condensed-homogeneous-functions], [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data], [def-sfb-condensed-action-module] and [def-sp-injective-resolutions], tensoring the underlying equivariant monomorphism with the free parameter is monic and the identity-coordinate transpose exists uniquely. More precisely, for internal equivariant modules N, M and J, an equivariant monomorphism i:N \to M and h:N \to H_n(J), with UJ injective, there is a unique internal map \alpha:A[G^n] \otimes UN \to UJ with \alpha_S([t]\otimes x)=h_S(x)(1,t) for every profinite test S and all local sections t,x.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-product-action-exact-forgetting] to the given group $G$: the forgetful functor $U_0$ is exact, hence carries the monomorphism $i$ to a monomorphism $Ui$. Apply the same statement to the profinite group $G^n$ (the trivial group for $n=0$). Its free internal module is $P_n=A[\underline G^n]$ and is flat, so its exact tensor functor carries $Ui$ to the required monomorphism $P_n\otimes_A Ui$.

source.place: Tag 03EO, lemma-internal-hom-adjoint-tensor (2); Tag 03EV, lemma-j-shriek-flat (2). Agent specialization to condensed modules and identity-coordinate evaluation.

proof.text: Use the underlying identification of $H$ in [def-sfb-condensed-homogeneous-functions]. For every $S$, $x\in N(S)$ and $f:T\to S$, define the slice map $b_S(x)$ on free generators by $b_S(x)_T([\mathbf t])=h_T(f^*x)(1,\mathbf t)$. Evaluation is of the slice morphism specified in [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. The free-module universal property and generator detection of [lem-sfb-condensed-free-linearization-tensor] extend this assignment uniquely linearly on the free presheaf and then to its sheafification, including on each localized site. Restrictions commute because both $h$ and evaluation commute with restrictions. Additivity and scalar linearity in $x$ follow from linearity of $h$ and of its slice evaluations. Thus these slice maps define an internal linear map $b:UN\to\mathcal Hom_A(P_n,UJ)$.

source.place: Tag 03EO, lemma-internal-hom-adjoint-tensor (2); Tag 03EV, lemma-j-shriek-flat (2). Agent specialization to condensed modules and identity-coordinate evaluation.

proof.text: Transport internal tensor to sheaf tensor by [lem-pe-internal-section-tensor-comparison], and transpose $b$ through the natural tensor--Hom bijection of [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. This gives $\alpha:P_n\otimes_A UN\to UJ$ with the displayed evaluation formula. For uniqueness, any other such map has a transpose whose slice component at $x\in N(S)$ agrees with $b_S(x)$ on every $[\mathbf t]$ over every $T\to S$, by the assumed formula applied to $f^*x$. Generator detection in [lem-sfb-condensed-free-linearization-tensor] makes those slice maps equal; bijectivity of transposition gives equality with $\alpha$.

lean.statement: theorem homogeneous_transpose_alpha (J : ActionModule R G) [Injective J.module] (n : ℕ) (H : HomogeneousFunctions R G J n) (N M : ActionModule R G) (i : N ⟶ M) [Mono i] (h : N ⟶ H.object) : Mono ((InternalBar.freePower R G n) ◁ i.val) ∧ ∃ α : InternalBar.freePower R G n ⊗ N.module ⟶ J.module, (∀ (S : Profinite.{u}) (t : Fin n → C(S, G)) (x : sectionModule R N.module S), InternalBar.onSections R α S (InternalBar.pureTensor R _ _ S (InternalBar.generator R G n S t) x) = homogeneousEvaluate R G J n S ((H.internalHom.hom.val.app (op S)).hom (InternalBar.onSections R h.val S x)) S (𝟙 S) (Fin.cons 1 t)) ∧ (∀ α' : InternalBar.freePower R G n ⊗ N.module ⟶ J.module, (∀ (S : Profinite.{u}) (t : Fin n → C(S, G)) (x : sectionModule R N.module S), InternalBar.onSections R α' S (InternalBar.pureTensor R _ _ S (InternalBar.generator R G n S t) x) = homogeneousEvaluate R G J n S ((H.internalHom.hom.val.app (op S)).hom (InternalBar.onSections R h.val S x)) S (𝟙 S) (Fin.cons 1 t)) → α' = α)
